text:
leo: Heads up — installed redwoodctl via snap on Ubuntu 22.04 and now localtest can't see my profiles and `login` fails with weird permission errors.

asha: Snap? Which channel (stable/edge) and did you use classic confinement?

leo: `snap install redwoodctl` (stable). Running `redwoodctl local serve --profile dev` gives: `failed to open profile store: permission denied` and `redwoodctl login --device` prints `can't spawn webbrowser: permission denied` even though I can `xdg-open` URLs fine.

tom: Snap packages are confined. They get a different $HOME and can't access $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR sometimes. Try `snap run --shell redwoodctl` and check `env` inside. Also check `ls -ld $HOME/.redwood` from inside the snap shell.

leo: Inside snap shell I see HOME=/home/lleo (note extra l in username), and `.redwood` is owned by root at `/root/.redwood`. I also see `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is empty.

asha: Root-owned config suggests you ran `sudo snap install` or the snap did setup as root. Snaps often create a segregated path. Workarounds: 1) remove snap and install the deb/tar.gz release, 2) reinstall snap with `--classic` (if we publish a classic snap) or 3) use a wrapper that sets HOME and XDG_* before launching. Example wrapper: `#!/bin/sh\nexport HOME=\"$HOME\"\nexport XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\"/run/user/$(id -u)\"\nexec /snap/redwoodctl/current/redwoodctl \"$@\"`

leo: Quick test: `rm -rf /home/leo/.redwood && mkdir -p /run/user/1000 && export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 && redwoodctl login --device` allowed device flow to open in my browser and complete. So that works locally.

tom: Filing a DX note: snap packaging currently causes profile dir collisions and missing runtime dirs which break device auth and localtest. We should either stop publishing snap, add a classic snap channel, or ensure the snap uses `snapcraft` interfaces for home and removable-media. Also update install docs to warn about confinement.

leo: Can we add `redwoodctl doctor` checks that detect runtime dir and profile ownership and print recommended fixes? Might save support tickets.

asha: Agreed — I'll add a small issue for `doctor` checks + docs update. For short term let's add a FAQ blurb.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4123: "snap confinement: profile ownership & XDG_RUNTIME_DIR checks + docs" and added to backlog.

leo: Thanks, saved my afternoon. Will avoid snap for now and use tarball. :relieved:
